# `house_disclosure_transactions`

**House reported transaction observations**

One qualified native PTR row with reported brackets, native blanks and every source-page fragment.

**Coverage.** Sampled. One declared retained index snapshot and explicitly selected periodic transaction report originals. Other categories are discovery only; image-form extraction and source-wide completeness remain unqualified. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

**Data quality.** Native blanks, ranges, repeated index entries and original/amended observations remain separate. Refused reading is not a valid empty report. Page regions retain unqualified checkboxes; annual sections and scanned transactions are outside this pilot.

- **Parquet file:** `house_disclosure_transactions.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `transaction_id` | `VARCHAR` | Identity of a row occurrence within one exact selected report version; not a net trade identity. |
| `report_id` | `VARCHAR` | Identity binding a selected index observation to one exact original PDF version. |
| `filing_id` | `VARCHAR` | Identity of one original index line in one retained index snapshot; repeated DocIDs remain separate observations. |
| `doc_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal House filing DocID; distinct from a native transaction ID. |
| `owner_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Printed ownership cell. Native blank remains an empty string and is never defaulted to Self. |
| `asset_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Complete multiline printed asset cell. Existing ticker-like text stays literal; no security identity is invented. |
| `action_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Printed purchase, sale, partial/full sale or exchange code; original spelling and line breaks remain. |
| `native_transaction_id` | `VARCHAR` | Printed transaction ID, including a native blank on a new row. It is not the filing DocID. |
| `transaction_date_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Printed transaction date, retained even when an amended report later states a different date. |
| `transaction_date_status` | `VARCHAR` | parsed, blank or unparsed for the transaction-date cell. |
| `notification_date_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Printed notification date, separate from transaction, filing and source capture dates. |
| `notification_date_status` | `VARCHAR` | parsed, blank or unparsed for the notification-date cell. |
| `amount_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Complete multiline reported amount bracket; not an exact cash amount. |
| `amount_status` | `VARCHAR` | reported_range, reported_exclusive_lower_bound, blank or unparsed. An exclusive lower bound remains exclusive. |
| `currency` | `VARCHAR` | USD only when an explicit dollar bracket was interpreted; null otherwise. |
| `filing_status_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Printed New or Amended transaction status; reports and rows are never automatically replaced or deduplicated. |
| `details_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Complete printed row details, including continuations across pages; native font glyphs remain visible. |
| `capital_gains_read_status` | `VARCHAR` | checkbox_not_qualified: the original page region retains the mark, but this reader does not interpret checkboxes. |
| `source_uri` | `VARCHAR` | Official URL of the selected original PDF. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the exact original PDF, separate from index and derived output hashes. |
| `page_locator` | `VARCHAR` | Official PDF URL with the one-based source page fragment. |
| `fragments_json` | `VARCHAR` | Every row page fragment with its source page, PDF-point bounds, original native word indices, text and word bounds. |
| `row_number` | `BIGINT` | One-based transaction occurrence in reading order within this exact PDF. |
| `page_number` | `BIGINT` | One-based page number in the original PDF. |
| `page_end` | `BIGINT` | Last original page containing this transaction row or its continued details. |
| `amount_lower_usd` | `BIGINT` | Reported bracket lower bound in US dollars; consult amount_status for exclusive bounds. Never an exact amount. |
| `amount_upper_usd` | `BIGINT` | Reported bracket upper bound in US dollars; null for open-ended, blank or unreadable brackets. |
| `transaction_date` | `DATE` | Parsed printed transaction date; does not rewrite a prior report when amended. |
| `notification_date` | `DATE` | Parsed printed notification date. |
